items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I recorded Louis Russell's Sweet Mom Taz. Yeah, right. That was Bob Shatner, Big God, myself, probably.

ctx.x: You heard that, what Jolly Roll talks about him? Yeah. But you recorded with all the Sims in 26, huh? We made some records.
And Louis Russell. I recorded Louis Russell's Sweet Mom Taz. Yeah, right. That was Bob Shatner, Big God, myself, probably.
